# compare-race

> Same prompt, several models -- stopwatch or true race; the starting model judges.
> Last-checked: 2026-09-13 | Version: 0.7.1 | Tests: 45 passed (100% green) | Lint: ruff clean

## Core idea

Fan one prompt out to N models (sequential = stopwatch, clean per-lane timing;
parallel = true race), optional repeats per model, collect artefacts, and let the
STARTING model write the verdict. Time is only ONE dimension: the judge rubric carries
quality, correctness, completeness, instruction fidelity, latency, cost.

## Identity (reused from system-auditor)

Six axes per run: time, prompt (slug+hash), system, model, run, variant. Attribute
only when exactly one axis varies: model->race, run->variance, time->model drift,
variant->twin/clone comparison. Artefact headers parse with
system_auditor.report.parse_front_matter (hard dependency).

## Execution & Evidence-Aware Starter Judge

COMA (spawn/file protocol/polling) is detected, not assumed: adapters claude/codex/
agy/kimi, per-lane model override. Without COMA: model-manual path via
`compare-race record`. Failed lanes are recorded (ok: false), never hidden. Optional
`lane_workdir` isolates inherited working directories on Python 3.10+, while raw
per-lane process logs are persisted below `_lane-logs` when `races_dir` is set.
Every run artefact carries a globally stable `lane_id` and explicit `evidence_kind`
(live, manual, simulated, blocked, failed, unknown). The starter judge (`compare_race.judge`,
`--judge`) admits only live/manual evidence and records explicit refusals for simulated,
blocked or unknown provenance lanes, writing a separate `JUDGE.md`.

## Governance & Runtime Invariants

- INV-LOCAL-01: 100% Offline / Zero-Egress (local subprocess orchestration, zero network telemetry)
- INV-SEC-02: Non-Elevation & User Mode (unprivileged execution without root/admin permissions)
- INV-AXIS-03: Six-Axis Attribution Discipline (time, prompt, system, model, run, variant)
- INV-JUDGE-04: Evidence-Aware Fail-Closed Judge (admission for live/manual only, refusal for unprovenanced)
- INV-ISOL-05: Safe Process Scoping & Working Directory Isolation (lane_workdir isolates cwd, logs in _lane-logs)
- INV-FAIL-06: Transparent Lane Accounting (failed lanes recorded with ok: false, never dropped)
- INV-BUNDLE-07: Descriptive Olympiad Separation (count, don't conclude; multi-discipline medal table)
- INV-INTEROP-08: Sibling Ecosystem Interoperability (coma, clutch, swarm-ai, system-auditor, marblerun)
- INV-LIC-09: 100% Permissive Audited Stack (MIT, PSFL-2.0, zero copyleft, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md)
- INV-SLA-10: Cryptographic Parity & Dual Security SLA (deterministic checks, 48-hour response SLA)

## Entry points

- prompts/RACE-STARTER.de.md + .en.md   role prompt (starter = judge by default)
- config/compare-race.config.example.json
- CLI: compare-race config|plan|run|record|report|olympiade (+ run --twin, run --judge)
- src/compare_race/: tokens, config, race, report, costs, judge, cli
- THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md: Audited permissive dependency inventory and compliance guarantees
- MARKETING-LOG.txt: Personas, competitive matrix, search intents, and runtime invariants

## Neighbours (optional)

coma (execution) · clutch (model catalogue) · swarm-ai (mechanical N-repeat
consensus) · MarbleRun (sequential chains). compare-race adds the qualitative judge
over sibling outputs and the repeats x models cross product.
